confidenceCalibration.claim: Learner demonstrates high confidence and speed on standard grammar rules and basic algebraic operations, but experiences minor confidence miscalibration on complex function transformations and signed inequality divisions where rushing leads to errors.

errorTaxonomy.label: Function Transformation & Intermediate Evaluation Error
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Failing to correctly execute horizontal/vertical shift composition g(x) = f(x+h) + k or stopping at an intermediate step when evaluating g(0).

errorTaxonomy.label: Inequality Direction Inversion Error
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Neglecting to flip the inequality sign when dividing both sides by a negative coefficient.

errorTaxonomy.label: Algebraic Polynomial Expansion Error
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Arithmetic error in calculating the linear coefficient b when expanding non-monic binomial products multiplied by a scalar factor and subtracted.

errorTaxonomy.label: Passage Trend Reversal Error
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Selecting an answer choice that claims a reduction in a biological emission when the text explicitly states an increase under environmental stress.

errorTaxonomy.label: Vocabulary Tone & Utility Misalignment
errorTaxonomy.mechanism: Selecting 'tentative' (uncertainty) rather than 'pragmatic' (practical trade-off) in a passage describing trade-offs between computational speed and accuracy.

executiveSummary: The learner completed a full-length mock SAT session Across this work the recorded date to the recorded date. Out of 90 total questions across Reading & Writing and Math (both on the higher difficulty adaptive route), the learner answered 84 correctly (93.3% overall accuracy), achieving an estimated total score of 1500 (Reading & Writing: 770, Math: 730). Performance in Reading & Writing was exceptional (52/54, 96.3%), while Math demonstrated strong foundational mastery with key targeted error patterns in composite function transformations, signed inequality directions, and multi-step polynomial expansion.

learnerModel.coachingStyle: Direct, evidence-bound, and analytical. Focus on step-by-step verification of function transformations, explicit sign-flip checks in inequalities, and precise text tracking in scientific passages.

hypotheses.claim: The learner has near-mastery of Standard English Conventions, Rhetorical Synthesis, Transitions, and Inferences in Reading & Writing, but can occasionally misread directional shifts in dense scientific passages.
In Math, the primary impediment to a 750+ score is procedural carelessness on multi-step function shifts g(x) = f(x + a) + b and negative inequality operations, rather than conceptual gaps.

learnerModel.nextSession: Focus on Math hard-level function transformations g(x) = f(x+h)+k, inequality division drills, and fast polynomial expansion checks, followed by 5 advanced Words in Context / Central Ideas passages.

priorities.claim: Master linear function transformation evaluation g(x) = f(x+h) + k without stopping at intermediate values or misapplying slope shifts.
Enforce mandatory inequality sign-reversal checks whenever dividing or multiplying by negative constants.
Double-check mental arithmetic during 3-step polynomial expansions ax(bx+c) - dx.

skillDirectives.reason: Accuracy of 33.3% (1/3) on linear function transformations indicates a critical procedural gap in evaluating g(0) = f(0+h) + k.
50% accuracy on linear inequalities due to missing sign flip when dividing by negative numbers.
75% accuracy (3/4) on equivalent expressions due to a timed expansion arithmetic error on difficulty 5 item.
75% accuracy (3/4) on central ideas due to misreading text directional claims (increase vs decrease).
87.5% accuracy (7/8) on words in context, missing tone precision on trade-off vocabulary ('pragmatic' vs 'tentative').

strengths.claim: Flawless execution across Standard English Conventions (Boundaries: 7/7, Form/Structure/Sense: 7/7), Expression of Ideas (Transitions: 6/6, Rhetorical Synthesis: 5/5), and Complex Inferences (4/4).
Solid command of Geometry & Trigonometry (Lines/Angles/Triangles: 2/2, Right Triangle Trig: 2/2, Area/Volume: 2/2, Circles: 1/1) and Advanced Math systems (Systems Linear/Nonlinear: 7/7 combined).

learnerModel.summary: Learner model updated following completion of adaptive mock this set. Overall score of 1500 (RW 770, Math 730) reflects elite RW analytical capabilities and robust Math problem-solving skills, with specific mechanical execution vulnerabilities in composite functions and signed inequalities.

limitations: Session evaluated a single full adaptive mock test (90 items).
No student reasoning notes were recorded in the event stream for qualitative thought-process verification.

misconceptionPatterns.claim: Confusing function input transformations f(x+h) with direct outputs or failing to apply vertical offsets post-evaluation.
Omitting the mandatory inequality direction flip when multiplying or dividing inequalities by negative numbers.
Overlooking directional verbs in scientific texts (e.g. increase vs decrease in emissions), leading to reversal traps.

pacingAndDecisions.claim: Pacing in Reading & Writing was exceptionally fast and efficient, averaging 32.5 seconds per item on difficulty 5 items, allowing comprehensive review time.
In Math, fast execution on standard items (<15s) enabled deep engagement with hard items, though occasional rushed execution on difficulty 5 items led to calculation slips.
